question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a brown ball, Bob has a silver ball, Claire has a red ball, Dave has a green ball, Eve has a teal ball, Fred has a gold ball, and Gertrude has a purple ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Finally, Alice and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Fred has the
Options:
(A) brown ball
(B) silver ball
(C) red ball
(D) green ball
(E) teal ball
(F) gold ball
(G) purple ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in the order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (brown, silver, red, green, teal, gold, purple)
1. Dave and Eve swap: (brown, silver, red, teal, green, gold, purple)
2. Eve and Claire swap: (brown, silver, green, teal, red, gold, purple)
3. Dave and Bob swap: (brown, teal, green, silver, red, gold, purple)
4. Dave and Alice swap: (silver, teal, green, brown, red, gold, purple)
5. Fred and Dave swap: (silver, teal, green, gold, red, brown, purple)
6. Dave and Alice swap: (gold, teal, green, silver, red, brown, purple)
7. Alice and Bob swap: (teal, gold, green, silver, red, brown, purple)
Fred has the brown ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
